page.text:
Before any mathematics can be stated precisely, we need a small
vocabulary for combining and relating statements. This opening chapter
records that vocabulary: the logical connectives that turn one or two
statements into a new one. Everything here operates on statements alone,
independently of what those statements happen to be about, so the
connectives defined below are used unchanged in every later chapter.
